title: rstack error report
description: The one JSON object that rstack and rstack dev print on stdout when --json is set and a command is refused or fails.

class.description: domain (exit 1): the request or the run's state was refused. usage (exit 2): the command line is wrong. operational (exit 3): the environment failed, for example PostgreSQL was unreachable or refused the connection, a product process could not be started, or no loopback port was available, or resources need cleanup.

run_id.description: Present when the failure concerns a run that still has resources to release.

recovery.description: Present with run_id when the resources to release are known.

field_encryption_key.description: Present when the run directory still holds the run's development field-encryption key file. The path only; the key itself is never reported.
